answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 4439 Country: India Title: After physical relation between husband and wife can a mother feed his baby, or she should have to take bath (Gusal)? Please suggest in this situation. Question: Assalam va alikum! After physical relation between husband and wife can a mother feed his baby, or she should have to take bath (Gusal)? Please suggest in this situation. Answer ID: 4439 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 433/433=M/1429) A mother can breastfeed her baby in a state of impurity ( janabah ), but it is better to have bath first. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
